name: inverse leg curl (on pull-up cable machine)
description: A bodyweight inverse leg curl using a pull-up cable machine setup. Targets the hamstrings.
instructions: Kneel on the seat of a pulldown machine, facing away, with your lower legs locked under the pads.
Keep your body straight from knees to head, hands ready in front of you.
Lean forward slowly, letting your hamstrings control the descent.
Catch yourself lightly on a low step if needed.
Pull yourself back up to kneeling with your hamstrings.
